lobby.title: Lobby Loop
lobby.prompt: Create a polished instrumental lobby loop for a live quiz game. Bright, welcoming, loopable, seamless, and cleanly mixed.
lobby.musicStyle: Upbeat game-lobby synth-pop with bright plucks, soft pulse bass, and a confident but friendly bounce

question.title: Question Loop
question.prompt: Create an energetic instrumental loop for the live-question phase of a quiz game. Driving, playful, loopable, and tension-building without being harsh.
question.musicStyle: Punchy electronic game-show underscore with propulsive drums, elastic synth bass, and bright arpeggios

answerSubmit.title: Answer Submit
answerSubmit.prompt: Create a short instrumental quiz-game sound effect for submitting an answer. Crisp click, soft whoosh, subtle digital sparkle, immediate impact.
answerSubmit.musicStyle: Short UI confirmation sting with bright synth transients, minimal bass, and a polished digital snap

answerAccepted.title: Answer Accepted
answerAccepted.prompt: Create a short celebratory confirmation cue for an answer being accepted. Warm success pop, tiny ascending flourish, clean game-show sheen.
answerAccepted.musicStyle: Bright success sting with a quick rising synth accent, soft chime tail, and a confident polished finish

timerUrgency.title: Timer Urgency
timerUrgency.prompt: Create a tense countdown sting for a quiz timer reaching the danger zone. Ticking energy, rising pressure, and a sharp polished finish.
timerUrgency.musicStyle: Urgent countdown sting with tight ticking percussion, rising synth tension, and a clean dramatic hit

leaderboardTransition.title: Leaderboard Transition
leaderboardTransition.prompt: Create a fast whoosh-and-sparkle transition cue for revealing the leaderboard in a quiz game.
leaderboardTransition.musicStyle: Fast transition effect with a polished whoosh, sparkling synth lift, and a crisp game-show sheen

podiumReveal.title: Podium Reveal
podiumReveal.prompt: Create a triumphant reveal hit for the final podium. Celebratory rise, punchy finish, and a premium game-show feel.
podiumReveal.musicStyle: Triumphant reveal sting with bold brass-like synths, sparkling accents, and a satisfying final hit

confettiCelebration.title: Confetti Celebration
confettiCelebration.prompt: Create a bright confetti burst with sparkling party energy and a joyful celebratory finish.
confettiCelebration.musicStyle: Party confetti burst with shimmering synth sprinkles, quick celebratory lift, and a clean festive tail
